documentedComponents.name: Marquee
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A short logo strip only when there is a real need. Never move publication titles.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Continuous motion; cloned children need accessibility handling.

documentedComponents.name: Terminal
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Read-only software catalogue on /software.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Sequence semantics, text availability and timers require source integration.

documentedComponents.name: Hero Video Dialog
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A project recording after an authentic recording is supplied.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Keyboard dialog behaviour, focus return and video loading must be tested.

documentedComponents.name: Bento Grid
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A regular two-column grid for selected research inside the main content panel.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Do not hide links until hover or force equal heights on long prose.

documentedComponents.name: Animated List
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A small chronological activity list when dated source material exists.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Avoid simulated notifications, looping updates and fabricated activity.

documentedComponents.name: Dock
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Six labelled destinations; desktop Dock and a three-column, two-row phone navigation.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Touch targets, keyboard focus, safe-area spacing and route state.

documentedComponents.name: Globe
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Academic-path card on the overview page.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: WebGL lifecycle, full config, deterministic orientation and accessible text.

documentedComponents.name: Tweet Card
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No embedded social stream in the professional site.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Third-party fetching and personal-content provenance add unnecessary work.

documentedComponents.name: Orbiting Circles
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A separate methods illustration only if it replaces another animation.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Would duplicate the visual role of Icon Cloud in the initial site.

documentedComponents.name: Avatar Circles
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Named collaborators only with suitable portraits and permission.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: A cluster of faces must not suggest unverified endorsements.

documentedComponents.name: Icon Cloud
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A visual companion to the semantic research-toolkit list on /software.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Local image assets, responsive canvas geometry and motion controls.

documentedComponents.name: Lens
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Inspection of a real, high-resolution scientific figure.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Do not use as the photography viewer. Provide full-image routes and an accessible lightbox.

documentedComponents.name: Pointer
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Keep the native pointer.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Custom pointer effects obstruct conventional interaction.

documentedComponents.name: Smooth Cursor
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Keep the native pointer.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: A second cursor and spring motion add no content value.

documentedComponents.name: Progressive Blur
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Do not blur the boundaries of readable content.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Can obscure links or text in compact reading panels.

documentedComponents.name: Dotted Map
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Photography index: owner-confirmed visited countries, derived travel total and country album entry points.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: SVG markers use the supplied projection; visits and albums have separate counts. Keep public country links, disable pulse and exclude private or unconfirmed records.
documentedComponents.reviewDepth: Implementation-level source inspection and official API documentation

documentedComponents.name: Animated Beam
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A labelled research-approach diagram on /research.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Conceptual links only; geometry, stop state and meaning require tests.

documentedComponents.name: Border Beam
documentedComponents.proposedUse: One finite emphasis around a featured software release.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Do not run another continuous effect beside an animated card.

documentedComponents.name: Shine Border
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Use a quiet solid border.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Persistent perimeter animation competes with reading.

documentedComponents.name: Magic Card
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Subtle pointer-following light on the selected-research cards.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Visible border and focus state must not depend on the effect.

documentedComponents.name: Glare Hover
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A restrained image hover treatment, instead of Magic Card.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Avoid stacking light effects on the same surface.

documentedComponents.name: Meteors
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No decorative particle shower.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Visual noise conflicts with the contained card design.

documentedComponents.name: Confetti
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No confetti interaction.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Contacting a scientist is not a celebratory product conversion.

documentedComponents.name: Particles
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A labelled illustration in a dedicated experiment page.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Never imply a measured scientific distribution or simulation result.

documentedComponents.name: Animated Theme Toggler
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A brief theme transition after integration with the existing theme provider.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Use one theme state; animated overlay and browser support need testing.

documentedComponents.name: Blur Fade
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A brief entrance for noncritical decorative content, once.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Names, navigation, paper titles and prose must be visible in server HTML.

documentedComponents.name: Text Animate
documentedComponents.proposedUse: One short editorial heading with finite motion.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Preserve a complete accessible string and fixed layout dimensions.

documentedComponents.name: Typing Animation
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Standalone demo reference; Terminal uses its own export.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Do not confuse the standalone API with TerminalTypingAnimation.

documentedComponents.name: Line Shadow Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No moving shadow on headings.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Reduces typographic restraint.

documentedComponents.name: Aurora Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No multicolour title treatment.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Conflicts with the single-accent palette.

documentedComponents.name: Video Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Keep video out of text masks.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Large payload with no communication benefit here.

documentedComponents.name: Number Ticker
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A derived, dated total only when a count has a clear purpose.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Never animate invented metrics, citations or proficiency scores.

documentedComponents.name: Animated Shiny Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Plain status text.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Repeated shimmer makes ordinary labels look like advertising.

documentedComponents.name: Animated Gradient Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Plain accent text.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Competes with the scientific figures and card hierarchy.

documentedComponents.name: Text Reveal
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Keep research prose readable without scrolling choreography.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Scroll-dependent readability is unsuitable for this content.

documentedComponents.name: Dia Text Reveal
documentedComponents.proposedUse: One finite accent on a short nonessential heading.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Test reduced motion and avoid duplicate word animations.

documentedComponents.name: Hyper Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Do not scramble the researcher name or terminology.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Temporary illegibility does not suit this site.

documentedComponents.name: Word Rotate
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Use a stable role and research summary.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Changing roles can blur professional positioning.

documentedComponents.name: Scroll Based Velocity
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No moving type bands.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Strong motion undermines compact reading.

documentedComponents.name: Sparkles Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No sparkling scientific headings.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Decorative tone is a poor fit.

documentedComponents.name: Morphing Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Use stable titles.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Word morphing compromises immediate comprehension.

documentedComponents.name: Spinning Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No revolving labels.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Adds distraction without information.

documentedComponents.name: Text Highlighter
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A single short phrase, never an entire paragraph.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Use restrained colour and a complete static text layer.

documentedComponents.name: Text 3D Flip
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No letter-by-letter 3D hover.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Interrupts reading and complicates touch behaviour.

documentedComponents.name: Safari
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Frame a real HerdLink screenshot on its detail page.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Do not fabricate interface screenshots; keep captions outside the frame.

documentedComponents.name: iPhone
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Only for a real mobile screenshot that helps explain an app.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Avoid a second device mock merely for decoration.

documentedComponents.name: Android
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Only for a documented Android experience.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: A frame must not imply native application availability.

documentedComponents.name: Rainbow Button
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Use plain, high-contrast action buttons.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Multiple hues conflict with the palette.

documentedComponents.name: Shimmer Button
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A single modest action treatment after visual review.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: No endless attention effect beside reading material.

documentedComponents.name: Ripple Button
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A local tap response on a real action.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Action semantics, focus and hit area remain conventional.

documentedComponents.name: Flickering Grid
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Use a static grid.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Flicker competes with content and needs additional motion handling.

documentedComponents.name: Animated Grid Pattern
documentedComponents.proposedUse: One dedicated concept illustration rather than a page background.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Random animation must not resemble scientific evidence.

documentedComponents.name: Retro Grid
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No perspective retro landscape.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Does not match the restrained vCard direction.

documentedComponents.name: Ripple
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No perpetual radial background animation.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Duplicates the motion already provided by the signature components.

documentedComponents.name: Dot Pattern
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A quiet alternative to Grid Pattern; use one of the two.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Keep the pattern out of body text.

documentedComponents.name: Grid Pattern
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A faint static grid inside the research-approach panel.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Decorative only, low opacity, no effect on content contrast.

documentedComponents.name: Hexagon Pattern
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A local static illustration if the hexagonal structure is meaningful.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Do not use it to imply actual spatial tessellation.

documentedComponents.name: Striped Pattern
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Small monochrome image framing rather than a whole page texture.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Check for visual interference at small screen sizes.

documentedComponents.name: Interactive Grid Pattern
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A contained experiment, not behind the biography.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Pointer interaction must not be the only content access.

documentedComponents.name: Light Rays
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No cinematic lighting in the page background.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Wrong visual scale for the chosen layout.

documentedComponents.name: Noise Texture
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Barely visible surface texture only after contrast review.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Do not rasterise a large texture or dirty the reading surface.

documentedComponents.name: Floating 3D Particles
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No additional particle field in the initial site.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Adds another continuous canvas renderer.

documentedComponents.name: Shiny Button
documentedComponents.proposedUse: An alternative single action treatment, not another button family.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Keep the button system consistent.

documentedComponents.name: File Tree
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A verified repository structure in a software article.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Never invent file paths or represent documentation as a file manager.

documentedComponents.name: Code Comparison
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A real, explained code comparison in future notes.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: No invented APIs or unsupported benchmark conclusions.

documentedComponents.name: Scroll Progress
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A thin progress indicator on research detail pages.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Never replace headings, anchor links or native scrolling.

documentedComponents.name: Neon Gradient Card
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Use the shared neutral card surface.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Heavy multicolour glow conflicts with the design.

documentedComponents.name: Comic Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No comic-book treatment.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Does not fit the professional voice.

documentedComponents.name: Kinetic Text
documentedComponents.proposedUse: One modest hover experiment on a short nonessential label.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Must remain legible and stable when motion is disabled.

documentedComponents.name: Cool Mode
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No pointer-triggered image bursts.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Adds novelty without useful content.

documentedComponents.name: Pixel Image
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A dedicated personal experiment after a suitable image is supplied.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Do not pixelate the main portrait or scientific figures.

documentedComponents.name: Pulsating Button
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No persistent pulsing actions.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Creates unnecessary urgency.

documentedComponents.name: Warp Background
documentedComponents.proposedUse: Use flat contained surfaces.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: The warp effect is too dominant for the reading layout.

documentedComponents.name: Interactive Hover Button
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A compact arrow transition for one consistent action style.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Keep visible text and keyboard behaviour stable.

documentedComponents.name: Animated Circular Progress Bar
documentedComponents.proposedUse: No percentage skill gauges.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: The CV supplies skills, not numerical competency measurements.

documentedComponents.name: Backlight
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A subtle edge around a real application image, instead of other glows.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Avoid stacking glow, glare and Magic Card.

documentedComponents.name: Glyph Matrix
documentedComponents.proposedUse: A small visual on a future experiment page.
documentedComponents.integrationConcern: Changing symbols must not suggest a running scientific analysis.

sourceExtras.kind: Source file outside the documented navigation
sourceExtras.support: Do not assume a supported registry entry or public API from the file alone.
